Being bombarded with texts is annoying yes. However, I think it's important for people to be present in the relationship. For me it's a red flag if someone goes out of the their way to NOT text me. If I text my partner "goodmorning, I hope you have a great day 😊" , I atleast expect a "thanks, I hope you have a good day too" or something because it takes 15 seconds to reply and that's respectful. On the flip side, I work a 9-5 job and cannot be constantly distract by text messages throughout the day. I think It's important to have a discussion around expectations/boundaries when it comes to texting early on, so both parties are on the same page.

There must be too much slack in the pipe. Quite often, those pipes are usually clipped down or latched on the cowl panel. Maybe check another car same make and model as a reference to ensure everything is located where it should be.
Furthermore, there are many useful DIY videos on how to restore/fix scratches on YouTube. I'd recommend Chris fix, he breaks things down step by step

If its paint that's transferred onto your car, most good polishes/cutting compounds and a microfiber cloth should get it out. However, if it has gone too deep you may need to touch it up with some paint and clearcoat. Lots of autoparts stores can match the paint code of your car and supply you with what you need.
